Phase 5 demo site (synthetic)

The stand-in for the five scenarios in docs/PHASE-5-DEMO.md. Nothing here talks to the network, there is no account, and every value is invented. It exists so the demo runs offline and identically every time, and so no real page is ever loaded during a recording.

The controls sit at fixed coordinates because the mock provider's phase5-* fixtures cite those exact boxes. Keep the window at 1280x800 or larger at 100% zoom, and do not scroll before approving a step.

The Email address field is redacted locally even while it is empty, which is why a plan can only refer to it by placeholder ([EMAIL]) and can only fill it from a private value the user saved — the demo's proof that the value never reaches the gateway.

Bottom of the page — seeing this means a scroll actually moved the viewport.
